description: Set the paths a PRIVATE app lets anyone read without signing in (GET and HEAD only), replacing the list. For the files a public site shows from a private app, such as a private Payload CMS's media (`/api/media/file/`), so its pictures and videos load for every visitor while the rest of the CMS stays private. Plain path prefixes, at most 5, each under 60 characters; `[]` closes them all. Tell the person which paths anyone will be able to read before you set them. The change reaches every edge location in about a minute. A public app ignores the list.

paths.description: Path prefixes, e.g. ['/api/media/file/']. [] closes them all.

project.description: Project id (prj_…) or the app's name (slug). Defaults to the project in deploy.json in the current directory.

name: open_paths
title: Paths anyone can read
